scenario: A `ttl 5_s` fact, pumped at 4_s and again at 6_s, is gone at the end: it expires via its TTL (LFAC.1.3.3) at the first pump after its deadline (RARC.5.2.4). Engine-managed TTL reaping. The vector has one count, at the end, so the 4_s pump is not checked.
rules_ds:
schema Heartbeat scope ttl 5_s:
    device_id: String
